title: Gettysburg time anchors (candidate)
description: Source of truth for the tick-to-clock function (chapter 04 sections 4.3-4.4, WP-TIME-02/03). CANDIDATE: nothing described here is approved by the historian or the owner. Structural rules that JSON Schema cannot express (strictly increasing ticks and minutes, slope limits, the evidence rule, tab ranges, sigma derivation) are enforced by src/lib/time/anchors.js (TM-V1) and tests/time.

version.description: Bumps on every anchor edit; the golden tick-clock table changes with it (TM-V11).

release.description: 'candidate' until the historian and the owner sign (D-TIME).

dv.description: Data (calibration) version stamp. 1 is the legacy calibration (links without dv); 2 is the first calibrated set.

tab_days.description: Inclusive tick ranges of the Day tabs. A tab is a tick range that names its first-light date; it is never printed as a calendar date.

approx_sigma_min.description: 'about' is printed when sigma >= this (register default 10) or the item is not signed.

t.description: Local mean time, zone-less, to the minute.

status.description: time-facts status: S solid, M medium, R needs a historian decision (range over 45 min or a conflict), D design anchor (no historical event).

effective_status.description: Status the model uses when it differs from 'status' (t5: circular, imported as D).

confidence.description: Evidence class: S=A, M=B, R=C, D=D.

sigma_min.description: [E] min(30, max(5, ceil(half-width of the widest linked fact range / 5) * 5)); design anchors 30.

range.description: Accepted window on the anchor's date (union of the linked fact ranges; sun-derived for design anchors).

facts.description: Rows of docs/plan/data/time-facts.csv (TIME:R### in the evidence file).

fact_confidences.description: Confidence (H/M/L) of each linked time-facts row, keyed by fact id. Empty for design anchors.

sources.description: Source keys exactly as printed in time-facts.csv.

families.description: [E] evidence families (OR, WP, ABT, HN, NPS, PART strong; SS, THJ, CWC, SRCH, LIT weak; sun for design anchors).

flags.description: H historian decides; O owner signs; C circular; M S-status on an M-confidence fact row; E S-status failing the evidence rule; W no strong family.

state.description: Sign-off states from docs/editorial/sign-off-states.md. Only 'signed' clears the 'about' pill, and only if sigma < 10.

decision.description: decisions.jsonl id once a decision exists.
